ShortDescription.Value: Automatically generates American, British and German road names.

Publish.LongDescription:
Road Name Generator automatically assigns road names based on the selected naming style.
## Supported naming styles
- American road names - British road names - German road names
## Features
- Automatically names newly created roads - Can rename existing roads - Several naming styles and road categories - Avoids duplicate road names - Optional logging for troubleshooting - Lightweight and runs automatically in the background
The naming style and other options can be configured in the game settings.
## Important notice
Road names are only generated or updated while the game simulation is running and game time is advancing.
If the game is paused, newly created or changed roads will be processed after the simulation is resumed.
## Compatibility notice
**Roads created with the Road Builder mod may currently not work reliably with the Road Name Generator.**
Improved compatibility is planned for a future update.
Publish.ChangeLog:
Version: 1.1.0
Changes:
* Significantly expanded the American, British, and German road name pools. * Added more names for residential roads, standard roads, avenues, alleys, dirt roads, and highways. * Added additional American and British road suffixes. * American alleys can now use suffixes such as Alley, Lane, Way, Court, Place, Row, Walk, Passage, Plaza, and Arcade. * Added more region-specific names for American highways and rural roads. * Added additional British special road names, rural tracks, mews, passages, and named major roads. * Expanded the German road name generator with additional residential streets, alleys, rural roads, avenues, city streets, and named highways. * German road names can now also be generated dynamically by combining suitable base names and suffixes. * Added duplicate-ending prevention for dynamically generated road names. * Prevented invalid or repetitive names such as “Mountain View View”, “Oak Ridge Ridge”, and “Waldwegweg”. * Improved the overall variety and regional authenticity of generated road names.
